from pathlib import Path
import struct,glob,os
for fn in glob.glob('test/shaping/data/in-house/fonts/*.ttf')[:20]:
    data=Path(fn).read_bytes()
    num=struct.unpack('>H', data[4:6])[0]
    off=12
    has=False
    for i in range(num):
        tag,cs,ofs,l=struct.unpack('>4sIII', data[off:off+16])
        if tag==b'name': has=True; break
        off+=16
    if has:
        print('has name',os.path.basename(fn))
        break
